fields.Name: T41 - Data Explorer Filter Enrollments by Status
fields.Description: Verifies that a column/value filter on the Enrollments grid can restrict results to Status = Completed.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K global search) and go to Data Explorer, then its Data section. In the left-hand entity tree open the 'Enrollments' entity. Wait patiently if the grid is slow to load (10-30s in this resource-constrained environment). Then apply a filter on the Status column (or via the grid's search/filter controls) so that only records with Status = 'Completed' are shown. Success is reached when the grid is visibly filtered to completed enrollments.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Enrollments entity grid is open in the Data Explorer Data section
A filter restricting Status to 'Completed' has been applied to the grid
The visible rows show Status = 'Completed' (no other status values appear in the filtered results)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
